subject: general
question: Nalanda University, an important centre in ancient period is situated in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nalanda University:-**

 
 
• It is considered as the world's first residential university and among the greatest centers of learning in the ancient world.
 
• **It was located near the city of Rajagriha (now Rajgir) and about 90 kilometres (56 mi) southeast of Pataliputra (now Patna).**
 
• Nalanda was founded in the 5th century CE and flourished for over 700 years, attracting scholars and students from all over Asia.
 
• It was a major center for the study of Buddhism, as well as other subjects such as philosophy, logic, mathematics, astronomy, and medicine.
 
• **The university was destroyed by the invading armies of Bakhtiyar Khilji in 1200 CE, but it remains an important symbol of India's rich cultural heritage.**
 
• In 2010, a new Nalanda University was established in Rajgir, near the site of the ancient university. The new university is an international and research-intensive university that offers postgraduate programs in a variety of disciplines. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihar:-**

 
 
• It is a state in eastern India.
 
• It is the third largest state by population, the 12th largest by area, and the 14th largest by GDP in 2021.
 
• Bihar borders Uttar Pradesh to its west, Nepal to the north, the northern part of West Bengal to the east, and Jharkhand to the south.
